articles.title: OpenAI puts $1 billion behind cyber defense after unveiling AI that can find zero-days
articles.snippet: The company is subsidizing access to its Daybreak security platform after saying Astra can independently find previously unknown software flaws and turn them into working attacks.

articles.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.

articles.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
articles.snippet: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.

articles.title: FinCEN ties $13B in crypto scams to non-US operations
articles.snippet: The agency reported that “transnational criminal organizations” based in compounds in Southeast Asia were largely behind digital asset scams targeting US residents.

articles.title: Michigan authorities continue pursuit to block Kalshi as Supreme Court fight looms
articles.snippet: Kalshi previously said it had been placed in an “impossible position” after federal authorities directed the company to ignore a Michigan restraining order issued in June.
